scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,client,fetcher -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev:fetcher"
scripts.stack: npm run --silent doppler -- docker compose up --build
scripts.doppler: set -a; [ -f backend/.env ] && . ./backend/.env; set +a; exec mise exec -- doppler run --
scripts.dev:fetcher: until curl -sf http://localhost:3001/contract > /dev/null; do sleep 1; done && cd youtube-fetcher && { set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; exec mise exec -- doppler run -- .venv/bin/python app/app.py; }
